scope: Verified partial tool set, not full request recovery

function.name: write_stdin
function.description: Writes characters to an existing unified exec session and returns recent output.

chars.description: Bytes to write to stdin (may be empty to poll).

max_output_tokens.description: Maximum number of tokens to return. Excess output will be truncated.

session_id.description: Identifier of the running unified exec session.

yield_time_ms.description: How long to wait (in milliseconds) for output before yielding.

function.name: update_plan
function.description:
Updates the task plan.
Provide an optional explanation and a list of plan items, each with a step and status.
At most one step can be in_progress at a time.

excluded.exec_command: Runtime feature flags change input schema; exact flags not in transcript.
excluded.kimi: Client release unidentified; active tool names alone do not establish definitions.
excluded.claude: Release 2.1.116 identified; runtime tool schemas and activation unavailable.
